reviews.title: Best Invention for Parents Sleeping Separately!
reviews.contents: We are able to see each others entries at all times if one of us is out for the day/couple hours when bubs was last feed, changed, temperature, sleeping. For example if one of us has bubs for the night sleeping in a different room to each other, taking in turns night/day shift, I can see when bubs fell asleep as hubby will start the sleep timer so then when it’s ‘hand over’ and bubs comes into my room, I can keep the sleep timer going on my phone. Life saver! It’s also handy to keep a track of bubs growth (weight, height, HC) so at appts I can easily access information, as well as feed averages and reports to compare to other babies at the same age. It’s interesting to compare how much sleep my baby is getting compared to other babies too and get tips from the app! Genuinely highly recommend this app!

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.contents: Great app, free version is really helpful. Could have some improvements to make it even better: 1) seven day download doesn't have any detail at the moment, it's just the picture. Would be great to have the notes from the day and the summary of each day. 2) ability to take notes against each entry. Eg this feed she was fussy and cried a lot. 3) note feature is buggy. If you write too much it doesn't scroll. 4) ability to start on one phone and stop on another (especially for sleep) 5) daily summary to also summarise number of feed on each breast

reviews.title: Good app but not worth the subscription cost.
reviews.contents:
I really like the summary of baby feeding/ sleeping/ pooping/ weight tracker etc send as PDF on request but that’s not enough in the baby app world in a paid subscription. There is plenty of free apps available on the market tracking those basic baby activities PLUS they offer other handy functions also free of charge (white noise, milestones, moms health tracker, activities for baby etc. ) 
Massive area of the development is the solid food selection menu. There is sooo many of the usual baby food ingredients that are not available in dropdown menu and it has to be marked as ‘other’. Option of edit the ‘other’ ingredient would be the quickest fix. 

As the mother’s mother I was under the impression that the other baby’s caregivers would be premium users as well since they are part of ‘my network’. No they are just basic users. 

And the biggest shortfall. Once my husband start sleep timer it won’t synchronise with my app up until HE stops it. What’s the point of sharing the app then?    Think nighttime care of the infant, do your really want to wake the other person to let them know when baby woke up so they can update the app accordingly? 

Lastly the Glow Forum articles aren’t baste on the factual information and sometimes is downright ‘heresay’.  

I use this up for 6 months and if I knew earlier about all those disadvantages I would simply go elsewhere (and save the money). There is plenty of fish...

reviews.title: Latest Update: Thumbs Down
reviews.contents: I love this app, including ‘Glow’ (which I used to track my fertility) and ‘Glow Pregnancy’ (which I used everyday during my pregnancy). I love that I’m in touch with other mothers from around the world whose babies were born in the same month as mine, and who also tracked their pregnancies right along with me. Having said all this, new update is awful. Suddenly annoying adverts appear in the middle of whatever I am reading and throughout the community message board. The user interface is already very busy with all the icons and menus, and is now further cluttered with thumbnail ads on every page. The only way to remove ads is to pay for the premium version. I understand that there are thousands of other apps which also operate in this way but it’s painful now with Glow Baby because it used to be such a pleasurable experience

reviews.title: Solid but some improved features could make it better
reviews.contents:
This app has helped us log all our baby’s feeds and movements easily. We are entirely bottle fed though and feel like the poor cousins. Needs settings to tailor whether you are breast, bottle or mixed. So as not to push the insights down your throat that are not relevant to your child

Also the premium subscription only works for for one parent so the other misses out logging the extra unless you shell out for two.

Timer is client side for baby sleep so if one parent starts it the other can’t stop it and the logging gets messy. Also once stopped can take over an hour to sync whilst the insights come through straight away making you feel like your baby hasn’t had enough sleep whilst it is the slow server not syncing data quick enough.

reviews.title: Useful app for forgetful mummy brain
reviews.contents: This app has been very useful in helping me keep track of wake hours and feeding times etc. Only thing that needs to change is the way you enter sleep times. For feeds you can start a timer and then stop it when baby finishes. This should also be able to be done for sleep times. I find I can’t remember what time my baby went to sleep by the time they’ve woken up, especially overnight when they’re waking me at 4am and my brain can barely function! Would also be good if there was a notes section as part of the feeding tracking to note any vomiting or large spit up etc. If those changes were made this app would be perfect in my eyes (without having to pay extra for premium)

reviews.title: Good tracker- terrible terrible advice!
reviews.contents: I love this app for the ability to track everything from sleep to feedings, even nappies. BUT what frustrates the hell out of me is ever single other part of the app! There’s SO much outdated stuff in this app from articles about crying it out (which is now NOT recommended by leading experts) to advice on withholding high allergen foods (which has been proven to increase the occurrence of food allergies) to “advice” designed to scare and intimidate new mothers into doing things a certain way (usually an outdated or sometimes a strict and regimented dangerous way).  I don’t ever use the community stuff, which is never monitored anyway and there’s a lot of weird stuff there, and I stopped reading the articles after they started upsetting me. But I do use the chart for logging feeds and sleeps. I should change to another app though and probably will to be honest.

reviews.title: This app saved my sanity
reviews.contents: This app saved my sanity! As a new Mum I felt completely overwhelmed, until I came across this app. I absolutely love the way it helps you find patterns, and helps you rise above the moment by plotting a graph of your whole day. It constantly helped me see the big picture. It feels like a tool for outsourcing my brain, and I don't need to use previous time and energy remembering feed times amd sleep times. It has helped me be more mindful, sit back and enjoy my newborn baby, and supported me every day. If you're thinking about downloading it just do it!

reviews.title: Review
reviews.contents:
I love this app it’s great and it’s perfect that it links to my Apple Watch to time breastfeeds, Enter nappy changes and sleep. What would be great to see is that the sleep timer turns off when you enter a nappy change or feed and that you can input colour of urine (good when baby is sick or to see if dehydrated)I also don’t like the update and the ads that come up in the timeline view, it’s just too messy and I have to scroll too far down to see what I entered within the last 12 hours. 
Overall really great free app and the paid version is helpful to see stats from other babies.

reviews.title: The app that saves our sanity
reviews.contents:
This app is super helpful especially for babies that a bit of extra attention, the hardest part was getting into the routine of remembering to log feeds or sleep cycles !! Our little man is 3 months old and just find it helps us track everything, super helpful when sleep deprived and the child health nurse asks you something and you can’t remember.. the app is here to help! 
It’s super thorough and gives a great little guide for milestones, teething, hint and tips and even helps keep track of solids when introducing food and testing for allergies!! Super helpful!!
